parameters.name: Height
parameters.description: The height of the watermark image, in pixels. This value is relative to `RefHeight` and will be scaled proportionally with the actual video resolution.

parameters.name: Name
parameters.description: The name of the watermark template.

parameters.name: OffsetCorner
parameters.description:
The anchor point for the watermark's position. Valid values:

- TopLeft

- TopRight

- BottomLeft

- BottomRight

parameters.name: PictureUrl
parameters.description: The URL of the watermark image.

parameters.name: RefHeight
parameters.description: The reference height of the video background, in pixels.

parameters.name: RefWidth
parameters.description: The reference width of the video background, in pixels.

parameters.name: TemplateId
parameters.description:
The ID of the watermark template.

> You can get the template ID from the response of the [AddLiveStreamWatermark](~~2848096~~) operation.

parameters.name: Transparency
parameters.description: The opacity of the watermark. Value range: `0` (fully transparent) to `255` (fully opaque).

parameters.name: XOffset
parameters.description:
The X-axis offset of the watermark, in pixels.

> Relative to RefWidth. If OffsetCorner is TopLeft, XOffset is the horizontal distance between the top‑left corner of the watermark and the top‑left corner of the background video. Positive X points to the right.

parameters.name: YOffset
parameters.description:
The Y-axis offset of the watermark, in pixels.

> Relative to RefHeight. If OffsetCorner is TopLeft, YOffset is the vertical distance between the top‑left corner of the watermark and the top‑left corner of the background video. Positive Y points downward.
